svg.title: Corsair Pinnace - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 101, PDF 102. Single-deck full hull keeps long rectangular block construction, narrowed middle and chamfered forward bridge. Bow right rotated up. Illustration corroborates longitudinal blocky hull; tall rear fin omitted from plan projection, internal troop/cargo borders and detached turret key excluded.
